```{ojs}
API_BASE = (
  (location.hostname === "localhost" ||
   location.hostname === "127.0.0.1") &&
  location.port !== "10000"
)
  ? "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
  : ""

apiJson = async path => {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`)

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `API indisponible (${path}) : HTTP ${response.status}`
    )
  }

  return await response.json()
}

dashboardPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/publications")
labsPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/labs")
partnersPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/partners")

publications = dashboardPayload.items ?? []
publicationLabsCluster = labsPayload.items ?? []
publicationPartners = partnersPayload.items ?? []
```

```{ojs}
yearOptions = [
  "Toutes",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.year)
        .filter(d => d != null)
        .map(d => String(d))
    )
  ).sort()
]

pillarOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.pillar)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]

axisOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.axis)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "" && d !== "No class")
    )
  ).sort()
]

labOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publicationLabsCluster
        .map(d => d.lab)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]

partnerOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publicationPartners
        .map(d => d.partner)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]
```

html`

## Explorer les collaborations

:::

::: {.collaboration-filter-grid}

::: {.filter-card}
**ANNÉE**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedYear = Inputs.select(yearOptions, {value: "Toutes"})
```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**PILIER**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedPillar = Inputs.select(pillarOptions, {value: "Tous"})
```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**AXE SCIENTIFIQUE**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedAxis = Inputs.select(axisOptions, {value: "Tous"})
```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**LABORATOIRE**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedLab = Inputs.select(labOptions, {value: "Tous"})
```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**PARTENAIRE**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedPartner = Inputs.select(partnerOptions, {value: "Tous"})
```
:::

:::

```{ojs}
publicationKey = d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s

selectedLabPublicationIds = new Set(
  selectedLab === "Tous"
    ? publications.map(publicationKey)
    : publicationLabsCluster
        .filter(d => d.lab === selectedLab)
        .map(d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s)
)

selectedPartnerPublicationIds = new Set(
  selectedPartner === "Tous"
    ? publications.map(publicationKey)
    : publicationPartners
        .filter(d => d.partner === selectedPartner)
        .map(d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s)
)

filteredPublications = publications.filter(d =>
  (selectedYear === "Toutes" || String(d.year) === selectedYear) &&
  (selectedPillar === "Tous" || d.pillar === selectedPillar) &&
  (selectedAxis === "Tous" || d.axis === selectedAxis) &&
  (selectedLab === "Tous" || selectedLabPublicationIds.has(publicationKey(d))) &&
  (selectedPartner === "Tous" || selectedPartnerPublicationIds.has(publicationKey(d)))
)

filteredPublicationIds = new Set(
  filteredPublications.map(publicationKey)
)
```

```{ojs}
filteredLabRelations = publicationLabsCluster.filter(
  d => filteredPublicationIds.has(d.publication_id)
)

filteredPartnerRelations = publicationPartners.filter(
  d => filteredPublicationIds.has(d.publication_id)
)
```

```{ojs}
labCollaborations = {
  const labsByPublication = d3.group(
    filteredLabRelations,
    d => d.publication_id
  )

  const pairCounts = new Map()

  for (const rows of labsByPublication.values()) {
    const labs = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(d => d.lab))).sort()

    for (let i = 0; i < labs.length; i++) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < labs.length; j++) {
        const lab1 = labs[i]
        const lab2 = labs[j]

        if (
          selectedLab !== "Tous" &&
          lab1 !== selectedLab &&
          lab2 !== selectedLab
        ) continue

        const pair = `${lab1} × ${lab2}`

        pairCounts.set(
          pair,
          (pairCounts.get(pair) || 0) + 1
        )
      }
    }
  }

  return Array.from(
    pairCounts,
    ([collaboration, publications]) => ({
      collaboration,
      publications
    })
  )
  .sort((a, b) => b.publications - a.publications)
  .slice(0, 8)
}

labPartnerCollaborations = {
  const labsByPublication = d3.group(
    filteredLabRelations,
    d => d.publication_id
  )

  const partnersByPublication = d3.group(
    filteredPartnerRelations,
    d => d.publication_id
  )

  const pairCounts = new Map()

  for (const publicationId of filteredPublicationIds) {
    let labs =
      (labsByPublication.get(publicationId) || [])
        .map(d => d.lab)

    let partners =
      (partnersByPublication.get(publicationId) || [])
        .map(d => d.partner)

    labs = Array.from(new Set(labs))
    partners = Array.from(new Set(partners))

    if (selectedLab !== "Tous") {
      labs = labs.filter(lab => lab === selectedLab)
    }

    if (selectedPartner !== "Tous") {
      partners = partners.filter(
        partner => partner === selectedPartner
      )
    }

    for (const lab of labs) {
      for (const partner of partners) {
        const pair = `${lab} × ${partner}`

        pairCounts.set(
          pair,
          (pairCounts.get(pair) || 0) + 1
        )
      }
    }
  }

  return Array.from(
    pairCounts,
    ([collaboration, publications]) => ({
      collaboration,
      publications
    })
  )
  .sort((a, b) => b.publications - a.publications)
  .slice(0, 8)
}

publicationsWithPartner = new Set(
  filteredPartnerRelations.map(d => d.publication_id)
).size

shortCollaborationLabel = value => {
  const text = String(value || "")

  return text.length > 38
    ? `${text.slice(0, 37)}…`
    : text
}
```

```{ojs}
html`
<section class="ecosystem-summary">

  <article class="ecosystem-stat">
    <span class="metric-label">PUBLICATIONS SÉLECTIONNÉES</span>
    <strong class="metric-value">
      ${filteredPublications.length.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}
    </strong>
    <span class="metric-note">après application des filtres</span>
  </article>

  <article class="ecosystem-stat">
    <span class="metric-label">AVEC PARTENAIRE PRIVÉ</span>
    <strong class="metric-value">
      ${publicationsWithPartner.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}
    </strong>
    <span class="metric-note">dans la sélection actuelle</span>
  </article>

  <article class="ecosystem-stat">
    <span class="metric-label">RELATIONS AFFICHÉES</span>
    <strong class="metric-value">
      ${labCollaborations.length + labPartnerCollaborations.length}
    </strong>
    <span class="metric-note">dans les deux classements</span>
  </article>

</section>
`
```

## Publications associées

:::

::: {.publication-search-card}

**RECHERCHE PAR TITRE OU AUTEUR**

```{ojs}
viewof publicationSearch = Inputs.text({
  placeholder: "Ex. transformer, Dupont, robotique..."
})
```

:::

```{ojs}
publicationSearchQuery =
  String(publicationSearch || "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()

displayedPublications = filteredPublications
  .filter(
    d =>
      publicationSearchQuery === "" ||
      String(d.title || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(publicationSearchQuery) ||
      String(d.authors || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(publicationSearchQuery)
  )
  .slice()
  .sort(
    (a, b) =>
      Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0) ||
      String(a.title || "").localeCompare(String(b.title || ""))
  )
```

```{ojs}
html`
<div class="publication-result-summary">
  <strong>${displayedPublications.length.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</strong>
  publication${displayedPublications.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}
  correspondant à la sélection
</div>
`
```

::: {.publication-card}

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(
  displayedPublications.map(d => ({
    Année: String(d.year ?? ""),
    Titre: d.title || "",
    Auteurs: d.authors || "",
    Pilier: d.pillar || "",
    Axe: d.axis || "",
    Statut:
      d.classification_status === "to_review"
        ? "À confirmer"
        : "Validé",
    Citations:
      d.citations == null || d.citations === ""
        ? ""
        : Number(d.citations),
    HAL: d.url || "",
    DOI: d.doi || ""
  })),
  {
    rows: 8,

    columns: [
      "Année",
      "Titre",
      "Auteurs",
      "Pilier",
      "Axe",
      "Statut",
      "Citations",
      "HAL",
      "DOI"
    ],

    width: {
      Année: 70,
      Titre: 330,
      Auteurs: 240,
      Pilier: 145,
      Axe: 200,
      Statut: 105,
      Citations: 85,
      HAL: 85,
      DOI: 85
    },

    format: {
      Citations: value =>
        value === "" || value == null
          ? "—"
          : value.toLocaleString("fr-FR"),

      HAL: value =>
        value
          ? html`<a href=${value} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">HAL</a>`
          : "",

      DOI: value => {
        if (!value) return ""

        const doiUrl =
          String(value).startsWith("http")
            ? value
            : `https://doi.org/${value}`

        return html`<a href=${doiUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">DOI</a>`
      }
    }
  }
)
```
